text:
Nina (Partnerships): FYI — SummitEdge (HW vendor) wants a joint listing next week. We need to lock what goes public vs private. @Alex @Sofia quick guidance?
Alex (Security): Public: short SOC2 snippet + redacted pen test exec summary. Private: full reports, raw scanner outputs, firmware debug logs, and cert private material. No raw PII.
Sofia (Marketplace): We require a signed attestation and 7-14 day presigned links for reviewers. Prefer filenames be predictable. Who will upload?
Diego (HW SI): SummitEdge asks if we can publish a firmware SHA only and a sanitized SBOM. They can provide both.
Alex (Security): SHA256 ok. SBOM must have vendor names only; strip internal package IDs. Also remove device serials from logs.
Nina (Partnerships): Ruth — any attestation wording constraints for firmware claims?
Ruth (Legal): Keep attestation factual, list scope, avoid liability language. Use marketplace attestation template. I'll post it.
artifact-bot: presign preflight: path `s3://redwood-marketplace/evidence/summitedge-2026-03/`. TTL 1209600s (14 days) available. Example: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/evidence/summitedge-2026-03/<file> --expires-in 1209600`.
Sofia (Marketplace): Suggested public manifest:
```
- soc2-summary.pdf (redacted)
- pen-test-summary.pdf (redacted)
- attestation-signed.pdf
- firmware-sha256.txt
- public-sbom.txt (redacted)
```
Diego (HW SI): SummitEdge will run scrub CI and upload to presign path Tue EOD.
Alex (Security): Redaction checklist: remove serials, IPs, customer names, private keys, exact stack traces. Add redaction note on top.
Ruth (Legal): I'll share template -> https://redwood.internal/legal/templates/marketplace_attestation_hw.pdf
Nina (Partnerships): Owners & deadlines: SummitEdge upload Tue EOD (Diego lead), Ruth attestation Wed AM, Alex redaction Wed PM, Sofia presigns Thu AM, Partnerships finalize Thu PM. Primary contact for review: Nina, backup Diego.
Sofia (Marketplace): I'll post presign links here once ready.
Nina (Partnerships): Thanks all — aim for Friday announcement if we clear reviews.
